title_sq: SHITET AMBIENT KOMERCIAL PRANE KOPSHTIT BOTANIK
description_sq:
Prona pozicionohet ne katin 0 te nje objekti te ri prane kopshtit botanik ne rrugen Selite e vjeter. 
Ambienti ka nje siperfaqe neto prej 389 m2 e cila organizohet ne open space me nje fasade te madhe xhami dhe akses te plote te makinave nga garazhi. 
Mund te sherbeje per tipologji te ndryshme biznesi si zyra, dyqan, depo, punishtge etj. 
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. 
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni.
title_en: COMMERCIAL PREMISES FOR SALE NEAR THE BOTANICAL GARDEN
description_en: The property is located on the 0th floor of a new building near the botanical garden on Selite e Veter Street. The environment has a net surface of 389 m2 which is organized in open space with a large glass facade and full access for cars from the garage. It can be used for different types of business such as offices, stores, warehouses, workshops, etc. The property has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, contact us.
